tools.name: context
tools.description: Get API domain context: resource taxonomy, auth requirements, query tips, and unique capabilities. Call this first.

tools.name: import
tools.description:
Import data from a JSONL file by issuing POST requests for each record.
Each line must be a valid JSON object. Failed records are logged to stderr
but do not stop the import.

args.description: Additional positional arguments or raw CLI flags to append to the command.

batch-size.description: Records per batch (future: batch API support) (default: 1)

compact.description: Return only key fields (id, name, status, timestamps) for minimal token usage (default: false)

csv.description: Output as CSV (table and array responses) (default: false)

data-source.description: Data source for read commands: auto (live with local fallback), live (API only), local (synced data only) (default: auto)

deliver.description: Route output to a sink: stdout (default), file:<path>, webhook:<url>

dry-run.description: Preview import without sending requests (default: false)

human-friendly.description: Enable colored output and rich formatting (default: false)

idempotent.description: Treat already-existing create results as a successful no-op (default: false)

input.description: Input JSONL file path (use - for stdin)

no-input.description: Disable all interactive prompts (for CI/agents) (default: false)

plain.description: Output as plain tab-separated text (default: false)

profile.description: Apply values from a saved profile (see 'uspto-tsdr-pp-cli profile list')

quiet.description: Bare output, one value per line (default: false)

rate-limit.description: Max requests per second (0 to disable) (default: 0)

select.description: Comma-separated fields to include in output (e.g. --select id,name,status)

yes.description: Skip confirmation prompts (for agents and scripts) (default: false)

tools.name: raw-image_get-image
tools.description: Parameter is the digits only of the serial number, no leading sn. Example: https://tsdrapi.uspto.gov/ts/cd/rawImage/78787878. Required: serial_number.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Full-text search across all synced data. Faster than paginating list endpoints. Requires sync first.

query.description: Search query (supports FTS5 syntax: AND, OR, NOT, quotes for phrases)

tools.name: sql
tools.description: Run read-only SQL against local database. Use for ad-hoc analysis, aggregations, and joins across synced resources. Requires sync first.

query.description: SQL query (SELECT or WITH...SELECT). Tables match resource names.

tools.name: sync
tools.description:
Sync data from the API into a local SQLite database. Supports resumable
incremental sync (only fetches new data since last sync) and full resync.
Once synced, use the 'search' command for instant full-text search.

Exit codes & warnings:
  Resources the API denies access to (HTTP 403, or HTTP 400 with an
  access-policy body) are reported as warnings rather than failing the
  run. In --json mode each is emitted as a {"event":"sync_warning",...}
  line carrying status, reason, and message fields, and a final
  {"event":"sync_summary",...} aggregates the run.

  Exit 0 when at least one resource synced and no resource flagged in
  the spec as critical (x-critical: true) failed; non-critical failures
  emit {"event":"sync_warning","reason":"exit_policy_default_changed",
  ...} so callers can detect that a partial failure was tolerated. Pass
  --strict to exit non-zero on any per-resource failure. Exit is always
  non-zero when every selected resource failed, regardless of --strict.

compact.description: Return only key fields (id, name, status, timestamps) for minimal token usage (default: false)

csv.description: Output as CSV (table and array responses) (default: false)

data-source.description: Data source for read commands: auto (live with local fallback), live (API only), local (synced data only) (default: auto)

deliver.description: Route output to a sink: stdout (default), file:<path>, webhook:<url>

human-friendly.description: Enable colored output and rich formatting (default: false)

idempotent.description: Treat already-existing create results as a successful no-op (default: false)

latest-only.description: Refresh head of each resource only; clears resume cursor and caps pages at 1. Mutually exclusive with --since (--since wins). (default: false)

max-pages.description: Maximum pages to fetch per resource (0 = unlimited; cap-hit emits a sync_warning event) (default: 100)

no-input.description: Disable all interactive prompts (for CI/agents) (default: false)

plain.description: Output as plain tab-separated text (default: false)

profile.description: Apply values from a saved profile (see 'uspto-tsdr-pp-cli profile list')

quiet.description: Bare output, one value per line (default: false)

rate-limit.description: Max requests per second (0 to disable) (default: 0)

select.description: Comma-separated fields to include in output (e.g. --select id,name,status)

strict.description: Exit non-zero on any per-resource failure (default: only critical failures or all-resource failure exit non-zero). (default: false)

yes.description: Skip confirmation prompts (for agents and scripts) (default: false)
